summary: Ranked, unexecuted next goals after Round33 (BA1-BD2). Every goal is a fixed-lattice question with a named missing premise, stated for a named model; none is a fraction of the continuum problem. The goals come from the reviewed obligations table (BC1, 21 rows), the BC2 and BD1/BD2 obligation rows and the three closing lens updates (experts/*/update-4.md). The five Round32 goals are disposed in inherited_goal_dispositions: dynamics and whole-sequence convergence were executed (BA2, BB1/BB2), the uniqueness goal only in the narrow O1a form (O1b is carried forward), the uniform-in-a goal remains open as obligation N10, and the triggered-only second-order goal is carried forward unexecuted.
ranking_basis: Advisor decision after the closing lens updates: route-B dynamics is rank 1 because all three lenses rank it and its route is fully named (the BA2 Duhamel comparison re-instantiated with the route-B interaction norm); uniqueness beyond the named constructions (O1b) is rank 2 as the best-defined discriminating target (Jung and modern lenses), with the historical lens's preference for finite-box certificates recorded; finite-box certificates (nodes and the F2 sign at N=2,3) are rank 3 (historical and Jung lenses); the correlation rate beyond N=14000 is rank 4 (modern lens); the AM2/AQ chain for Z2 with the external transverse-field Ising cross-check is rank 5 (all three lenses name a group chain). The modern lens's area law via a zero-free region is recorded as a dissent below rank 5; the phrase-scanner vocabulary fix is a methods decision to apply before any Round34 contract is frozen.

goals.title: Dynamics and correlation functions for the route-B uniform model
goals.target: Re-instantiate the BA2 Duhamel comparison and within-family Cauchy estimates for the route-B named construction with the route-B interaction norm ||Phi'||_F <= 2349|tau| (AX1), then the BB2 item-5 correlation-function bound for its limit on |theta| at most 8.
goals.missing_premise: No route-B dynamics comparison exists (BC2 excludes it); the BA2 constants use ||Phi||_F <= 2268|tau|.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Single direction plus skeptic: recompute the Nachtergaele-Sims constants from the committed excerpt with the route-B norm and the route-B boundary source, and check the comparison coefficient against a pre-frozen target with margin 2.
limitations: Algebraic dynamics of one named construction on a compact window; not GNS dynamics of different states and not uniform in time.

goals.title: Uniqueness of the local restriction beyond the named constructions (O1b)
goals.target: Prove that every ground state in a pre-frozen AM2-admissible class of boundary conditions agrees on R with the limit of the named constructions, by a Dobrushin- or HTW-type condition with evaluated constants at |tau|<=10^-8.
goals.missing_premise: BB2 identifies only the limits of F1 and F2 (O1a); no evaluated two-state estimate covers other boundary conditions (O1b open).
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Evaluate a Dobrushin interdependence matrix for the AM2 fixed point on a small centered box in exact arithmetic and check whether the uniqueness condition holds at the cap; a failure is not evidence of non-uniqueness.
limitations: A failed condition is not evidence of non-uniqueness.
Uniqueness on R within a named class is not uniqueness of every infinite-volume ground state.

goals.title: Finite-box node certificates and the padded-box sign at N=2,3
goals.target: Certify the centred Euclidean Wilson node at s=1 for finite F1 and F2 boxes (not restated in BC1 because the AV2 record states the node only for limits) and the static Wilson-mean sign for F2 boxes at N=2 and N=3.
goals.missing_premise: The AV2 window lemma is stated for the limit's GNS vector; the F2 sign at N=2,3 needs a box-level form of the AY1 K_2' bound (ungated).
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Re-prove the AV2 window lemma box by box with the finite-box generator and the volume-uniform D; gate the box-level K_2' reading of AY1 F13-F14 and recompute the N=2,3 sign margin (labelled candidate about 51.8).
limitations: Finite-box statements at fixed N; no rate of node convergence.

goals.title: A correlation-function rate in N beyond N=14000
goals.target: Replace the frozen r_N=floor((N-1)/2) by a pre-frozen choice that keeps the region-form factor e^{|Lambda_{r_N}|/10^8} bounded, giving a rate for every N.
goals.missing_premise: The BB2 item-5 bracket is vacuous from N=14419 on with the frozen r_N.
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Freeze r_N proportional to log N (or a power below one third) before production and certify the bracket for every N with exact arithmetic.
limitations: Compact time window only; the Lieb-Robinson function is polynomial.

goals.title: The AM2/AQ chain for Z2 lattice gauge theory with an external cross-check
goals.target: Re-instantiate the AM2 fixed point, the AV1 state lemma and the AQ construction for Z2 under the BD1 convention (gap 2, E[W^2]=1), and compare low-order coefficients in 2+1 dimensions with the Wegner duality to the transverse-field Ising model.
goals.missing_premise: BD1 transfers only the flip lemma, the parity theorem and the first-order coefficient; no AM2/AQ chain exists for any group other than SU(2).
goals.proposed_first_loop_test: Paired: recount the AM2 constants for Z2 and compare a second-order coefficient with the dual Ising series computed independently.
limitations: A Z2 statement is not an SU(2) statement; no dictionary to a continuum coupling.
